caption: The TP cell holds the 80 caught spam; the 20 false spam and 10 missed spam sit beside it. Precision is 80 ÷ (80+20) = 0.800 and recall is 80 ÷ (80+10) = 0.889, so F1 is 0.842 and accuracy is 970 ÷ 1000 = 0.970.

spec.title: Confusion matrix; columns: actual spam, actual ham
spec.aria: A two-by-two confusion matrix for 1000 emails: 80 true spam, 20 false spam, 10 missed spam and 890 true ham, with TP, FP, FN and TN marking the cells.
